network.add_your_institutional_affiliation_a_dec: Add your institutional affiliation. A declared affiliation is separate from verified employment or authority to manage library records.
network.end_this_affiliation_and_its_service_aut: End this affiliation and its service authority
network.show_this_affiliation_on_my_public_profi: Show this affiliation on my public profile
network.follow_its_progress_in_grouped_requests_: Follow its progress in Grouped requests or Your submissions. We’ll let you know if more information is needed.
network.confirm_that_you_work_for_this_service_o: Confirm that you work for this service or network.
network.request_staff_access_to_a_reviewed_set_o: Request staff access to a reviewed set of libraries.
network.employment_verification_confirms_your_af: Employment verification confirms your affiliation. Management approval grants access only to the libraries a moderator approves. Evidence is private.
network.manage_staff_and_delegate_access_as_an_o: Manage staff and delegate access as an owner
network.editor_access_is_the_default_owner_respo: Editor access is the default. Owner responsibility requires an explicit moderator decision and reason.
network.explain_your_relationship_and_requested_: Explain your relationship and requested authority
network.connect_the_approved_delegation_scope_to: Connect the approved delegation scope to my Team
network.approved_management_can_support_assignme: Approved management can support assignments from your Team within the reviewed scope. Payment does not verify service authority.
network.explore_library_services_university_syst: Explore library services, university systems and consortia. Each page lists its published member libraries and available source information.
network.search_for_all_or_part_of_a_service_univ: Search for all or part of a service, university system or consortium name.
network.choose_a_public_library_service_a_univer: Choose a public library service, a university system or a consortium connecting institutions.

network.open_the_whole_network_in_atlas: Open the whole network in Atlas →
network.some_updates_need_retrying_completed_upd: Some updates need retrying. Completed updates will be preserved.
network.this_removes_access_derived_from_the_ser: This removes access derived from the service mandate, including Team assignments based on it. Independent claims remain.
network.filters_search_the_whole_network_an_unre: Filters search the whole network. An unrecorded facility does not mean it is unavailable.
network.search_by_service_or_network_name: Search by service or network name

network.affiliation_verifies_where_you_work_mana: Affiliation verifies where you work. Management access is reviewed separately.
network.no_affiliations_yet_verified_connections: No affiliations yet. Verified connections can appear on your profile when you choose to share them.
network.verifies_your_connection_to_an_instituti: Verifies your connection to an institution.

network.enables_shared_workspaces_and_widgets_pu: Enables shared workspaces and widgets. Public maps can follow a service as its membership changes.

network.start_with_a_service_or_choose_records_i: Start with a service or choose records individually.
network.name_your_team_workspaces_are_free: Name your Team. Workspaces are free.
network.bring_colleagues_together_and_publish_yo: Bring colleagues together and publish your first widget.
network.library_management_authority_is_reviewed: Library management authority is reviewed separately. New service additions are reviewed as a batch.
network.connect_your_service_for_widget_defaults: Connect your service for widget defaults. Confirm whether to add its current published libraries to Team coverage.
network.add_its_current_libraries_to_team_covera: Add its current libraries to Team coverage
network.existing_libraries_remain_future_source_: Existing libraries remain. Future source additions require a separate coverage decision and a batch management review.

networkModeration.membership_is_recorded_from_public_sourc: Membership is recorded from public sources

networkModeration.membership_describes_a_sourced_relations: Membership describes a sourced relationship; it does not establish ownership or staff authority.

networkModeration.approval_created_a_new_library_record: Approval created a new library record.
